root_cause: An upstream database update in the feature store introduced a target leakage bug where the training pipeline incorporated tomorrow's transaction data to calculate today's feature values. This led to high validation metrics in development but a severe accuracy drop from 91% to 54% when served online.
fix_applied: Reconfigured the feature store time-travel logic to exclude transaction timestamps equal to or greater than the prediction timestamp. Re-aggregated features, retrained the model (version v2.1), and deployed it to the staging environment before routing traffic.
outcome: Resolved. Production accuracy recovered to 89% and matched offline validation metrics without further anomalies.
